subject.title: Feature: TTS delivery mode option — separate text + voice messages on Telegram

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in Telegram TTS delivery policy for separate text-plus-voice delivery, and should that policy live in global `messages.tts` or Telegram/channel-specific config?
rationale: The source-level UX problem is real, but the requested fix is a new public config/API contract that overlaps active captioned-final and broader text-delivery policy work.

options.title: Approve a narrow opt-in policy
options.body: Define a backward-compatible `bundled` versus `separate` delivery contract with schema, docs, and Telegram plus TTS tests before implementation.

options.title: Standardize captioned delivery
options.body: Keep captioned Telegram voice as the supported default and document tagged/manual split plus overflow fallback instead of adding a new selector.

options.title: Defer until captioned-final settles
options.body: Wait for the related captioned-final PR direction to land or close before choosing the permanent delivery-mode surface.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow opt-in policy
recommendation.body: Define a backward-compatible `bundled` versus `separate` delivery contract with schema, docs, and Telegram plus TTS tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans TTS config, plugin/channel contracts, docs, and Telegram delivery behavior, and prior issue history points to this person as the strongest routing candidate across those surfaces.
